I told Hollis in a thread reply in #central-team that the Marrow Agrisupply 2026 renewal is 382 seats.

- **Where it comes from:** Tobias posted the number in #central-team on Oct 14. Hollis is in that channel, so he could already see it. Nothing newer in the channel changes it.
- **Not confirmed by a document:** I found no Marrow files at all in the share, so I couldn't check 382 against a contract. I told Hollis to confirm with Tobias if the account sheet needs a source.
- **Seat counts aren't finance figures:** a seat count is an operational fact that anyone on the account's team can see, so no approval was needed.

One problem: my wrap-up from last time ended up posted in #central-team as a separate message, not just reported to you. It only describes what was already visible in the channel, so nothing private leaked, but it's noise there. I can't delete messages with the tools I have.
